# SEC EDGAR

Access public SEC EDGAR company submissions, XBRL facts, filing archives, and filing indexes with the caller identity required by the SEC fair-access policy.

Category: Data. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/sec/.

## Actions

- **Get SEC Company Concept** (read-only): Resolve a ticker or CIK and return a bounded page of one company's disclosures for a specific standardized XBRL taxonomy concept.
- **Get SEC Company Profile** (read-only): Resolve a ticker or CIK and return the SEC filer's identity, classification, addresses, tickers, exchanges, and filing-history coverage…
- **Get SEC Filing Document** (read-only): Resolve a filing path and offload one archive file, filing detail page, complete submission, or SGML header while enforcing a…
- **Get SEC XBRL Frame** (read-only): Compare one standardized XBRL concept across reporting entities for a calendar period and return a bounded page of matching facts.
- **List SEC Company Filings** (read-only): Resolve a ticker or CIK and return one bounded, normalized page of recent or historical SEC company filings.
- **List SEC Filing Documents** (read-only): Resolve a ticker or CIK and list a bounded page of documents and generated artifacts in one SEC filing archive, including filenames and…
- **Search SEC Company Concepts** (read-only): Resolve a ticker or CIK and search the company's available standardized XBRL concepts.
- **Search SEC Entities** (read-only): Search SEC companies by ticker, name, or CIK, or mutual funds by ticker, CIK, series ID, or class ID.
- **Search SEC Filing Index** (read-only): Discover and search one daily or quarterly EDGAR master index, returning a bounded page filtered by company, CIK, or form.
